items.title_cn: 胰腺炎：急性和慢性疾病的综合概述
items.title_en: Pancreatitis: An Integrated Overview of Acute and Chronic Disease
items.abstract_cn: 胰腺炎代表了一组影响胰腺的异质性炎症性疾病，仍然是全球范围内胃肠道疾病发病和死亡的重要原因。它广义上包括以突发胰腺炎症为特征的急性胰腺炎（AP），以及一种进行性纤维炎症性疾病，导致不可逆的结构和功能损害，即慢性胰腺炎（CP）。其病因谱多样，包括胆结石、饮酒、高甘油三酯血症、基因突变、自身免疫机制以及梗阻性胰腺疾病。本章全面概述了胰腺炎的流行病学、病因学、病理生理学、分类、临床表现、诊断方法和治疗策略。讨论了修订版亚特兰大分类和现代严重程度评估工具在急性疾病风险分层中的应用。当前基于证据的治疗强调早期液体复苏、及时的营养支持、有效的疼痛控制以及对胰腺坏死等并发症的微创处理。对于CP，本章重点介绍了疼痛管理策略、胰腺酶替代治疗、内镜干预、手术选择以及相关糖尿病的处理。还探讨了特殊临床情况，包括高甘油三酯血症诱发的胰腺炎、自身免疫性胰腺炎和妊娠期胰腺炎。同时综述了近期进展，如内镜超声引导下干预、腔壁贴合金属支架、新型生物标志物、人工智能辅助成像以及基于微生物组的研究。通过整合当代诊断和治疗理念，本章旨在为临床医生、研究人员和学生提供对胰腺炎及其不断演变的管理策略的简明而全面的理解。精准医学和微创治疗学的持续进步有望进一步改善患者预后和生活质量。
items.abstract_en: Pancreatitis represents a heterogeneous group of inflammatory disorders affecting the pancreas and remains a significant cause of gastrointestinal morbidity worldwide. It broadly encompasses acute pancreatitis (AP), characterized by sudden pancreatic inflammation, and chronic pancreatitis (CP), a progressive fibro-inflammatory condition leading to irreversible structural and functional impairment. The etiological spectrum is diverse, including gallstones, alcohol consumption, hypertriglyceridemia, genetic mutations, autoimmune mechanisms, and obstructive pancreatic disorders. This chapter provides a comprehensive overview of the epidemiology, etiology, pathophysiology, classification, clinical manifestations, diagnostic approaches, and management strategies for pancreatitis. The Revised Atlanta Classification and modern severity assessment tools are discussed for risk stratification in acute disease. Current evidence-based management emphasizes early fluid resuscitation, timely nutritional support, effective pain control, and a minimally invasive approach to complications such as pancreatic necrosis. For CP, the chapter highlights strategies for pain management, pancreatic enzyme replacement therapy, endoscopic interventions, surgical options, and management of associated diabetes mellitus. Special clinical scenarios, including hypertriglyceridemia-induced pancreatitis, autoimmune pancreatitis, and pancreatitis during pregnancy, are explored. Recent advances such as endoscopic ultrasound-guided interventions, lumen-apposing metal stents, novel biomarkers, artificial intelligence–assisted imaging, and microbiome-based research are also reviewed. By integrating contemporary concepts in diagnosis and treatment, this chapter aims to provide clinicians, researchers, and students with a concise yet comprehensive understanding of pancreatitis and its evolving management. Continued progress in precision medicine and minimally invasive therapeutics promises to further improve patient outcomes and quality of life.
items.summary_cn: 该章节全面综述了急性和慢性胰腺炎的流行病学、病因、病理生理、分类、临床表现、诊断与治疗策略，涵盖修订版Atlanta分类、重症风险评估、微创坏死处理、内镜干预及EUS引导治疗等，并探讨了高甘油三酯血症性胰腺炎、自身免疫性胰腺炎等特殊场景及人工智能、微生物组等前沿进展。

items.title_cn: 白细胞介素17在重症急性胰腺炎中的作用：人体回顾性初步研究
items.title_en: Role of Interleukin 17 in Severe Acute Pancreatitis: Human Retrospective Pilot Study
items.abstract_cn: 背景/目的：重症急性胰腺炎占急性胰腺炎发作的20%，并具有较高的死亡风险。该疾病的全身严重程度由大量细胞因子释放驱动，其中白细胞介素-17（IL-17）作为促炎级联反应的关键调节因子发挥作用。本研究旨在评估入院时血清IL-17对重症急性胰腺炎的预后价值，并将其与多器官功能障碍及临床-生物学结局进行相关性分析。方法：对35例重症急性胰腺炎患者队列进行回顾性分析。提取人口学、病因学及临床-生物学基线特征。采用ELISA法测定入院时血清IL-17水平，并对数据进行统计分析。结果：在发生多器官衰竭的患者中观察到IL-17水平显著升高。通过ROC分析确定了预测器官功能障碍的预后阈值：神经系统功能障碍（AUC = 0.814，p = 0.003）和急性呼吸窘迫综合征（AUC = 0.756，p = 0.024）为≥19.77 pg/mL；呼吸功能障碍（p = 0.004）和心血管功能障碍（AUC = 0.820，p = 0.002）为≥18.45 pg/mL；肾功能障碍（AUC = 0.735，p = 0.020）为≥19.81 pg/mL。此外，单因素二元logistic回归分析确定，血清IL-17升高是入住重症监护病房患者死亡的重要预后因素（OR = 1.062，p = 0.048）。结论：入院时血清IL-17是一种重要的预后生物标志物，可反映重症急性胰腺炎严重的全身促炎状态，并提示后续器官功能障碍和死亡风险。将IL-17纳入初始风险分层方案可能有助于临床医生及时升级治疗。
items.abstract_en: Background/Objectives: Severe acute pancreatitis accounts for 20% of acute pancreatitis episodes and carries a substantial mortality risk. The systematic severity of the disease is driven by a massive cytokine release, with Interleukin-17 (IL-17) acting as a crucial modulator of the pro-inflammatory cascade. This study aimed to evaluate the prognostic value of serum IL-17 at admission and correlate it with multi-organ dysfunctions and clinical-biological outcomes in patients with severe acute pancreatitis. Methods: A retrospective analysis was conducted on a cohort of 35 patients with severe acute pancreatitis. Demographic, etiological, and clinical-biological baseline characteristics were extracted. Serum IL-17 levels were determined at admission using the ELISA method, and data were statistically analyzed. Results: Significantly higher levels of IL-17 were observed in patients who developed multi-organ failure. Prognostic thresholds were identified via ROC analysis to predict organ dysfunctions: ≥19.77 pg/mL for neurological dysfunction (AUC = 0.814, p = 0.003) and acute respiratory distress syndrome (AUC = 0.756, p = 0.024); ≥18.45 pg/mL for respiratory (p = 0.004) and cardiovascular dysfunctions (AUC = 0.820, p = 0.002); and ≥19.81 pg/mL for renal dysfunction (AUC = 0.735, p = 0.020). Furthermore, univariate binary logistic regression identified elevated serum IL-17 as a significant prognostic factor for mortality among patients admitted to the intensive care unit (OR = 1.062, p = 0.048). Conclusions: Serum IL-17 at admission functions as a significant prognostic biomarker that reflects the severe systemic pro-inflammatory status in severe acute pancreatitis and mirrors the risk of subsequent organ dysfunctions and mortality. Incorporating IL-17 into initial risk stratification protocols may assist clinicians in timely therapeutic escalation.
items.summary_cn: 该回顾性研究在35例重症急性胰腺炎患者中发现，入院时血清IL-17水平显著升高与多器官功能衰竭相关，并通过ROC分析确定了预测神经、呼吸、心血管及肾功能障碍的阈值（约18.45–19.81 pg/mL）；单因素logistic回归显示IL-17升高是ICU患者死亡的重要预后因素（OR=1.062, p=0.048）。

items.title_cn: 白细胞介素17联合全身参数在中重度急性胰腺炎严重程度分层和死亡率预测中的作用
items.title_en: The Role of Interleukin 17 in Association with Systemic Parameters in Severity Stratification and Mortality Prediction in Moderate and Severe Acute Pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 引言：急性胰腺炎是一种炎症性病变，可导致多器官功能障碍，并具有较高的死亡率。其发病机制复杂，核心要素为全身性炎症。本探索性研究旨在识别有助于对中度和重度急性胰腺炎进行严重程度分层和死亡预测的参数，以及评估IL-17对疾病严重程度的预测价值。材料与方法：在2024年10月至2025年8月期间，对64例符合条件的中度和重度急性胰腺炎患者进行了回顾性研究。根据观察表、病史和临床检查收集人口学、病因学和生物学数据。同时，采用ELISA技术定量检测IL-17水平。所有数据均进行了适当的统计分析。结果：在64例病例中，35例（54.69%）为重度急性胰腺炎。从临床-人口学数据中，我们确定个人心血管和肾脏病理既往史是死亡的独立危险因素（分别为OR = 7.529和OR = 24）。此外，代谢性病因是死亡的危险因素（OR = 5.625）。在生物学参数中，红细胞沉降率≥ 41.29 mm/h和AISI评分≥ 1627.50在预测严重程度方面具有较高的敏感性和特异性。白细胞增多、C反应蛋白（CRP）、IL-17和低钙血症是发生重度急性胰腺炎的预测危险因素（分别为OR = 3.733、OR = 1.136、OR = 1.068和OR = 3.542）。其中，仅CRP、IL-17和低钙血症是死亡的危险因素（OR = 1.051、OR = 1.080、OR = 6.771）。关于住院管理中的重症监护天数，并发症和器官功能障碍是死亡的危险因素。结论：本研究识别了有助于在现有评分系统之外对中度和重度急性胰腺炎患者进行严重程度分层的有用参数，以及死亡的危险因素。此外，IL-17提供了参与这些患者发病机制、严重程度演变和生存的有用信息。尽管IL-17具有前景广阔的作用，但由于样本量较小，这些发现仍属初步结果，需要外部验证。
items.abstract_en: Introduction: Acute pancreatitis is an inflammatory lesion that can lead to multiple organ dysfunctions and has an increased mortality rate. The pathogenic mechanisms are complex. A central element is represented by systemic inflammation. This exploratory study aims to identify parameters useful in stratifying the severity of moderate and severe acute pancreatitis and predicting mortality, as well as in evaluating the predictive value of IL-17 regarding disease severity. Material and Methods: A retrospective study was conducted during the period October 2024–August 2025 on an eligible group of 64 patients with moderate and severe acute pancreatitis. Demographic, etiological, and biological data were collected according to the observation sheets, anamnesis, and clinical examination. Also, the level of IL-17 was quantified by the ELISA technique. All data were appropriately analyzed statistically. Results: Of the 64 cases, 35 (54.69%) had severe acute pancreatitis. From the clinical–demographic data, we identified personal cardiovascular and renal pathological antecedents as independent risk factors for death (OR = 7.529 and OR = 24, respectively). Also, metabolic etiology represented a risk factor for death (OR = 5.625). From the biological parameters, erythrocyte sedimentation rate ≥ 41.29 mm/h and AISI score ≥ 1627.50 have a role in predicting severity with quite high sensitivity and specificity. Leukocytosis, C-reactive protein (CRP), IL-17, and hypocalcemia represent predictive risk factors for the occurrence of severe acute pancreatitis (OR = 3.733, OR = 1.136, OR = 1.068, and OR = 3.542, respectively). Of these, only CRP, IL-17, and hypocalcemia represent risk factors for death (OR = 1.051, OR = 1.080, OR = 6.771). Regarding the in-hospital management of intensive care days, complications and organ dysfunctions are risk factors for death. Conclusions: This study identified useful parameters adjunct to the current scoring systems to stratify patient severity in moderate and severe acute pancreatitis, as well as risk factors for mortality. In addition, IL-17 provides useful information involved in the pathogenesis, evolution of severity and survival in these patients. Despite the promising role of IL-17, these findings remain preliminary due to the small sample size and require external validation.
items.summary_cn: 该回顾性研究在64例中重度急性胰腺炎患者中发现，IL-17、CRP和低钙血症是发生重症急性胰腺炎的预测危险因素，其中仅CRP、IL-17和低钙血症为死亡的危险因素；此外，心血管和肾脏基础病史及代谢性病因也是死亡的独立危险因素，ESR≥41.29 mm/h和AISI评分≥1627.50对预测严重程度具有一定敏感性和特异性。

items.title_cn: 新型炎症标志物SII、SIRI、AISI和MII在重症急性胰腺炎识别中应用的临床研究
items.title_en: A clinical study on the application of new inflammatory markers SII, SIRI, AISI, and MII in the identification of severe acute pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn:
急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种以突然发作为特征的炎症性疾病。如果进展为重症急性胰腺炎（SAP），死亡率会显著升高。目前的临床评分系统较为复杂。因此，临床需要廉价、快速、准确且易于使用的新型炎症标志物。本研究旨在评估以下新型炎症标志物在入院时预测SAP以及入院48 h后评估AP严重程度的临床价值：全身免疫炎症指数（SII）、全身炎症反应指数（SIRI）、全身炎症综合指数（AISI）、多炎症指数-I（MII-1）、多炎症指数-II（MII-2）、多炎症指数-III（MII-3）。

对石家庄市人民医院收治的374例AP患者进行了回顾性分析，其中重症组58例，非重症组316例。采用受试者工作特征曲线分析和成对DeLong检验比较各标志物的性能。针对每种炎症标志物分别构建多变量logistic回归模型，并校正临床因素。使用2,000次bootstrap重抽样对校正模型进行内部验证。

SII、SIRI、AISI、MII-1、MII-2和MII-3均为AP严重程度的统计学显著指标（P < 0.05）。入院时，这些炎症标志物对SAP的总体预测性能相对有限，AUC范围为0.589至0.694；SII的AUC最高，为0.694。入院48 h后，MII-1、MII-2和MII-3在评估AP严重程度方面表现出中等至良好的区分性能，AUC分别为0.790、0.778和0.780。校正临床因素后，所有三个MII指数仍与SAP显著相关。校正后的MII-1、MII-2和MII-3模型在入院48 h后的表观AUC分别为0.819、0.807和0.804，乐观校正后的AUC分别为0.800、0.786和0.783。

MII-1、MII-2和MII-3在入院48 h后评估AP严重程度方面表现出中等至良好的区分性能，尤其是MII-1，且在校正临床因素后其与SAP的关联仍然显著。这些发现应被视为探索性和假设生成性的，仍需进一步研究以验证MII指数在AP严重程度评估中的潜在价值。
items.abstract_en:
Acute pancreatitis (AP) is an inflammatory disease characterized by sudden onset. The mortality rate increases significantly if it progresses to severe acute pancreatitis (SAP). Current clinical scoring systems are complex. Consequently, there is a clinical need for novel inflammatory markers that are inexpensive, fast, accurate, and easy to use. Herein, we aimed to evaluate the clinical value of the following novel inflammatory markers for predicting SAP at admission and assessing AP severity at 48 h after admission: the systemic immune-inflammation index (SII), systemic inflammatory response index (SIRI), aggregate index of systemic inflammation (AISI), multi-inflammatory index-I (MII-1), multi-inflammatory index-II (MII-2), multi-inflammatory index-III (MII-3).
 
 
 
 A retrospective analysis was conducted on 374 patients with AP hospitalized at Shijiazhuang People's Hospital, including 58 cases in the severe group and 316 cases in the non-severe group. Receiver operating characteristic curve analysis and pairwise DeLong tests were used to compare marker performance. Separate multivariable logistic regression models were constructed for each inflammatory marker with adjustment for clinical factors. Internal validation of the adjusted models was performed using 2,000 bootstrap resamples.
 
 
 
 
 The SII, SIRI, AISI, MII-1, MII-2, and MII-3 emerged as statistically significant (
 P
  < 0.05) indicators of AP severity. At admission, the overall predictive performance of the inflammatory markers for SAP was relatively limited, with AUCs ranging from 0.589 to 0.694; SII showed the highest AUC of 0.694. At 48 h after admission, MII-1, MII-2, and MII-3 showed moderate-to-good discriminatory performance for assessing AP severity, with AUCs of 0.790, 0.778, and 0.780, respectively. After adjustment for clinical factors, all three MII indices remained significantly associated with SAP. The adjusted MII-1, MII-2, and MII-3 models yielded apparent AUCs of 0.819, 0.807, and 0.804 at 48 h after admission, with optimism-corrected AUCs of 0.800, 0.786, and 0.783.
 
 
 
 
 MII-1, MII-2, and MII-3 showed moderate-to-good discriminatory performance for assessing AP severity at 48 h after admission, particularly MII-1, and their associations with SAP remained significant after adjustment for clinical factors. These findings should be considered exploratory and hypothesis-generating, and further studies are needed to validate the potential value of MII indices in AP severity assessment.
items.summary_cn: 该研究评估了SII、SIRI、AISI及MII等新型炎症标志物对重症急性胰腺炎的识别价值，发现入院时预测性能有限（AUC 0.589-0.694，SII最高），而入院48小时后MII-1、MII-2、MII-3对AP严重程度具有中等至良好的区分能力（AUC分别为0.790、0.778、0.780），校正临床因素后仍与SAP显著相关（校正后AUC为0.800、0.786、0.783）。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎血液净化前后多系统实验室变化：141例真实世界描述性分析
items.title_en: Multisystem laboratory changes before and after blood purification in acute pancreatitis: a real-world descriptive analysis of 141 cases
items.abstract_cn:
急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种动态的多系统疾病。血液净化（BP）在重症或高甘油三酯相关AP中的应用日益增多，然而BP后实验室指标变化的整体模式及跨维度异质性仍缺乏充分表征。

利用真实世界数据，描绘AP患者接受BP前后配对实验室参数变化的模式、幅度、跨系统相关性及患者层面异质性，严格不推断因果疗效。

这项回顾性观察性研究分析了141例连续接受BP（血液灌流、血浆置换或联合治疗）的AP患者。比较了涵盖七个生物学领域的配对实验室指标。构建了一个探索性多系统实验室变化评分（0∼6）以评估方向一致性。采用基于规则的分层方法，结合变化幅度排序和亚组分析来检验变化模式。

大多数实验室指标在治疗后呈现下降。相对中位降幅最大的是IL-6（−86.79%）、血清淀粉酶（−86.67%）和甘油三酯（−86.23%）。平均多系统变化评分为4.24 ± 1.34；87.94%的患者在≥3个领域出现同向变化，70.92%的患者在≥4个领域出现同向变化。探索性分层识别出表现出较大、中等或较小多维变化的亚组。相关性分析显示肾脏参数在域内具有强同步性（r = 0.726），但跨域相关性较弱或无统计学意义。

AP患者在BP前后表现出显著且异质的多维实验室指标变化。由于缺乏同期对照组，这些观察性变化不能因果归因于BP，而是反映了疾病自然演变、液体复苏及同期支持治疗的共同影响。
items.abstract_en:
Acute pancreatitis (AP) is a dynamic, multisystem disorder. Blood purification (BP) is increasingly utilized in severe or hypertriglyceridemia-associated AP, yet the overall patterns and cross-dimensional heterogeneity of post-BP laboratory shifts remain poorly characterized.
 
 
 
 To map the patterns, magnitudes, cross-system correlations, and patient-level heterogeneity of paired laboratory parameter changes observed before and after BP in AP patients using real-world data, strictly without inferring causal efficacy.
 
 
 
 This retrospective observational study analyzed 141 consecutive AP patients receiving BP (hemoperfusion, plasma exchange, or combined). Paired laboratory indicators across seven biological domains were compared. An exploratory multisystem laboratory change score (0∼6) was constructed to evaluate directional consistency. Rule-based stratification was applied to examine change patterns alongside change-magnitude ranking and subgroup analyses.
 
 
 
 
 Most laboratory indicators exhibited post-treatment reductions. The largest relative median decreases occurred in IL-6 (−86.79%), serum amylase (−86.67%), and triglycerides (−86.23%). The mean multisystem change score was 4.24 ± 1.34; concurrent directional shifts occurred across ≥3 domains in 87.94% of patients and ≥4 domains in 70.92%. Exploratory stratification identified subgroups exhibiting greater, intermediate, or smaller multidimensional shifts. Correlation analysis demonstrated strong intra-domain synchrony between renal parameters (
 r
  = 0.726), but weak or non-significant cross-domain correlations.
 
 
 
 
 Patients with AP showed marked, heterogeneous pre- to post-BP multidimensional laboratory shifts. Lacking a contemporaneous control group, these observational changes cannot be causally attributed to BP and reflect the combined influence of natural disease evolution, fluid resuscitation, and concurrent supportive care.
items.summary_cn: 该回顾性研究分析了141例接受血液净化的急性胰腺炎患者，发现治疗后多数实验室指标下降，其中IL-6、血清淀粉酶和甘油三酯的相对中位降幅最大（约86%）；多系统变化评分平均为4.24±1.34，87.94%的患者在≥3个生物域出现同向变化，但跨域相关性较弱，提示血液净化后实验室变化具有多维异质性。

items.title_cn: 已发表的预测因素集与急性胰腺炎后复发性事件负担：一项单中心回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: Published predictor set and recurrent-event burden after acute pancreatitis: a retrospective single-center cohort study
items.abstract_cn: 复发性急性胰腺炎（RAP）在首次急性胰腺炎（AP）发作后较为常见，但已发表的RAP模型通常为推导研究，且很少关注复发事件负担。在这项回顾性单中心队列研究中，我们连续纳入了2018年1月1日至2021年10月31日期间首次因AP入院后出院、且出院后随访在行政上截断至2024年10月31日满36个月的成年患者。主要终点为出院后36个月内首次RAP；次要终点为RAP总发作次数，慢性胰腺炎（CP）进展以描述性方式总结。死亡记录为随访结局/删失信息。已发表的二分类列线图所报告的四个预测因子被拟合为可重复的、来源于原始研究的本地Cox比较模型。未评估未经修改的原始模型的绝对风险。另建了一个独立的本地de novo Cox模型，并通过嵌套多重插补bootstrap进行内部验证，总事件负担采用Prentice–Williams–Peterson间隔时间模型进行分析。全部859例患者均贡献了随访至首次RAP、死亡、末次接触或36个月的随访数据；15例无事件患者在36个月前失访，14例死亡。322例患者观察到首次RAP（粗比例37.5%），共分析693次复发事件。来源于原始研究的四变量本地比较模型的乐观校正Uno's C为0.69（95% CI 0.66–0.72），de novo本地Cox模型为0.74（95% CI 0.72–0.77）；后者36个月Brier评分为0.174（95% CI 0.158–0.190）。表观风险分层可区分累积复发事件负担。79例患者（9.2%）发生CP进展。在这项回顾性单中心队列中，使用已发表预测因子集拟合的本地模型显示出中等程度的内部验证区分度，而另一个独立的de novo本地模型显示出更高的内部验证性能。复发事件方法在首次复发时间之外提供了额外的负担信息；在临床使用前需要进行独立的多中心验证。
items.abstract_en: Recurrent acute pancreatitis (RAP) is common after a first acute pancreatitis (AP) episode, but published RAP models are usually derivation studies and rarely address recurrent-event burden. In this retrospective single-center cohort, we enrolled consecutive adults whose index discharge after a first AP admission occurred between January 1, 2018, and October 31, 2021, and administratively truncated follow-up at 36 months after discharge through October 31, 2024. The primary endpoint was first post-discharge RAP within 36 months; secondary endpoints were total RAP episodes, and chronic pancreatitis (CP) progression was summarized descriptively. Mortality was recorded as follow-up disposition/censoring information. The four predictors reported by a published binary nomogram were fitted as a reproducible, source-informed local Cox comparator. No unmodified-source-model absolute risk was evaluated. A separate de novo local Cox model was internally validated with nested multiple-imputation bootstrap, and total event burden was analyzed with a Prentice–Williams–Peterson gap-time model. All 859 patients contributed follow-up through first RAP, death, last contact, or 36 months; 15 event-free patients were lost before 36 months and 14 died. First RAP was observed in 322 patients (crude proportion 37.5%), and 693 recurrent episodes were analyzed. The optimism-corrected Uno’s C was 0.69 (95% CI 0.66–0.72) for the source-informed four-variable local comparator and 0.74 (95% CI 0.72–0.77) for the de novo local Cox model; the latter had a 36-month Brier score of 0.174 (95% CI 0.158–0.190). Apparent risk strata separated cumulative recurrent-event burden. CP progression occurred in 79 patients (9.2%). In this retrospective single-center cohort, a locally fitted model using the published predictor set showed moderate internally validated discrimination, while a separate de novo local model showed higher internally validated performance. Recurrent-event methods added burden information beyond time to first recurrence; independent multicenter validation is required before clinical use.
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题表明其研究了急性胰腺炎后的预测因素集与复发性事件负担，采用回顾性单中心队列研究设计。由于未提供摘要，无法总结具体核心发现。

items.title_cn: 胆道肿瘤的多模态内镜诊断：整合EUS引导组织获取与胆管镜实现个体化癌症诊疗
items.title_en: Multimodal endoscopic diagnosis in biliary oncology: integrating EUS-guided tissue acquisition and cholangioscopy for personalized cancer care
items.abstract_cn: 胆道恶性肿瘤的诊断仍然具有挑战性，原因在于胆管癌的生长模式具有异质性、传统组织获取技术的敏感性有限，以及在精准肿瘤学时代对分子分型日益增长的需求。在过去十年中，超声内镜（EUS）和数字单人操作胆管镜通过提供互补信息，改变了诊断方法。EUS能够实现高分辨率成像、局部区域分期，以及从原发肿瘤和区域淋巴结获取组织，而胆管镜则提供直接的胆管内可视化以及对可疑胆道病变的靶向活检。本综述总结了关于EUS引导下组织获取和胆管镜诊断性能、优势及局限性的当前证据，强调它们在当代诊断流程中的互补作用。我们还讨论了新兴技术，包括分子分型、下一代测序、人工智能、影像组学、数字病理学和液体活检，这些技术正在塑造胆道肿瘤学的未来。除现有证据外，我们还介绍了本机构在疑似恶性胆道狭窄患者中比较EUS引导下组织获取与胆管镜引导下活检的经验。本机构的经验支持在多模式诊断方法中互补使用EUS引导下组织获取和胆管镜。在同时接受两种操作的患者亚组中，我们观察到较高的诊断敏感性，同时保持了可接受的安全性特征，这支持多模式诊断方法可能具有的价值。将先进内镜技术与精准诊断相结合，可能有助于优化诊断准确性并指导胆道恶性肿瘤的个体化管理。
items.abstract_en: The diagnosis of biliary malignancies remains challenging because of the heterogeneous growth patterns of cholangiocarcinoma, the limited sensitivity of conventional tissue acquisition techniques, and the growing need for molecular profiling in the era of precision oncology. Over the past decade, endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) and digital single-operator cholangioscopy have transformed the diagnostic approach by providing complementary information. EUS enables high-resolution imaging, locoregional staging, and tissue acquisition from primary tumors and regional lymph nodes, while cholangioscopy offers direct intraductal visualization and targeted biopsy of suspicious biliary lesions. This review summarizes the current evidence on the diagnostic performance, strengths, and limitations of EUS-guided tissue acquisition and cholangioscopy, emphasizing their complementary role within contemporary diagnostic algorithms. We also discuss emerging technologies, including molecular profiling, next-generation sequencing, artificial intelligence, radiomics, digital pathology, and liquid biopsy, which are shaping the future of biliary oncology. In addition to the available evidence, we present our institutional experience comparing EUS-guided tissue acquisition and cholangioscopy-directed biopsy in patients with suspected malignant biliary strictures. Our institutional experience supports the complementary use of EUS-guided tissue acquisition and cholangioscopy within a multimodal diagnostic approach. In the subgroup of patients who underwent both procedures, we observed high diagnostic sensitivity while maintaining an acceptable safety profile, supporting the potential value of a multimodal diagnostic approach. Integrating advanced endoscopic techniques with precision diagnostics is likely to optimize diagnostic accuracy and guide personalized management of biliary malignancies.
items.summary_cn: 该综述总结了EUS引导组织获取与胆道镜在胆道恶性肿瘤诊断中的互补作用，强调两者联合的多模态诊断路径可提高诊断敏感性并保持可接受的安全性。同时讨论了分子分型、下一代测序、人工智能等新兴技术对未来胆道肿瘤精准诊疗的潜在影响。

items.title_cn: 间充质干细胞移植治疗重症急性胰腺炎相关肺损伤：动物研究的Meta分析
items.title_en: Mesenchymal stem cell transplantation for severe acute pancreatitis-associated lung injury: A meta-analysis of animal studies
items.abstract_cn:
背景
 本研究旨在评估间充质干细胞（MSCs）治疗急性呼吸窘迫综合征-急性肺损伤（ALI）的疗效，从而为未来干细胞治疗胰腺炎相关急性肺损伤的临床应用提供循证参考。
 目的
 系统评价MSC移植治疗重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）-ALI的疗效。
 方法
 电子检索中国知网、万方数据、中国生物医学文献数据库、PubMed和Web of Science等数据库，检索自建库至2024年8月1日关于MSC移植治疗SAP-ALI的动物实验。由两名研究者独立检索文献、提取数据并评估各研究的偏倚风险。采用RevMan 5.4软件进行Meta分析。
 结果
 共纳入13项随机对照动物实验，涉及248只大鼠，其中MSC组124只，模型对照组124只。Meta分析表明，MSC移植降低了SAP大鼠胰腺组织和肺组织的组织病理学评分[标准化均数差（SMD）= -3.12，95%置信区间（CI）：-3.99至-2.25]。此外，MSC移植降低了肺湿干重比（加权均数差= -0.50，95%CI：-0.64至-0.36）、髓过氧化物酶活性（SMD = -3.29，95%CI：-4.40至-2.19）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）水平（SMD = -3.57，95%CI：-5.49至-1.64）及其mRNA表达（SMD = -3.74，95%CI：-5.27至-2.20）以及血清TNF-α水平（SMD = -3.51，95%CI：-4.51至-2.51）。与对照组相比，MSC组血清淀粉酶水平显著降低（SMD = -3.63，95%CI：-4.54至-2.72）。
 结论
 MSC移植可减轻SAP大鼠的肺部炎症反应并缓解SAP-ALI。然而，由于纳入研究数量和样本量有限，仍需进一步开展多中心、大规模随机对照试验以验证我们的发现。
items.abstract_en:
BACKGROUND
 This study is to evaluate the efficacy of mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) in the treatment of acute respiratory distress syndrome-acute lung injury (ALI), so as to provide evidence-based reference for the clinical use of stem cells in the treatment of acute lung injury associated with pancreatitis in the future.
 AIM
 To systematically evaluate the efficacy of MSC transplantation in the treatment of severe acute pancreatitis (SAP)-ALI.
 METHODS
 Databases, including China National Knowledge Infrastructure, Wanfang Data, SinoMed, PubMed, and Web of Science, were electronically searched for animal experiments on MSC transplantation for SAP-ALI from inception of the databases to August 1, 2024. Two researchers independently retrieved the literature, extracted data, and assessed the risk of bias of individual studies. Meta-analysis was performed using the RevMan 5.4 software.
 RESULTS
 A total of 13 randomized controlled animal experiments were included, involving 248 rats, with 124 rats in the MSC group and 124 in the model control group. Meta-analysis indicated that MSC transplantation reduced the histopathological scores of pancreatic tissues and lung tissues [standardized mean difference (SMD) = -3.12, 95% confidence interval (CI): -3.99 to -2.25] in SAP rats. Additionally, MSC transplantation decreased lung wet-to-dry weight ratio (weighted mean difference = -0.50, 95%CI: -0.64 to -0.36), myeloperoxidase activity (SMD = -3.29, 95%CI: -4.40 to -2.19), and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) level (SMD = -3.57, 95%CI: -5.49 to -1.64) and its mRNA expression (SMD = -3.74, 95%CI: -5.27 to -2.20) as well as serum TNF-α levels (SMD = -3.51, 95%CI: -4.51 to -2.51). Compared with the control group, the MSC group had significantly lower serum amylase levels (SMD = -3.63, 95%CI: -4.54 to -2.72).
 CONCLUSION
 MSC transplantation can reduce the pulmonary inflammatory response and alleviate SAP-ALI in SAP rats. However, due to the limited number of included studies and sample size, further multicenter, large-scale randomized controlled trials are warranted to validate our findings.
items.summary_cn: 该Meta分析纳入13项动物实验（248只大鼠），发现间充质干细胞移植可降低重症急性胰腺炎大鼠胰腺和肺组织的病理评分，减轻肺湿干重比、髓过氧化物酶活性及TNF-α水平，并降低血清淀粉酶水平，从而缓解胰腺炎相关急性肺损伤。但作者指出纳入研究数量和样本量有限，需进一步多中心大样本随机对照试验验证。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
